name: Wix
description: The Wix MCP provides users with the ability to manage their account's websites and apps (Stores, Bookings, Blog etc.). In addition, the MCP also helps devs create new sites using Wix Headless, the Wix Design system and more.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wix to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.wix.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Wix MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Wix scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wix MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wix provides these MCP tools: WixREADME, SearchWixWDSDocumentation, SearchWixRESTDocumentation, SearchWixSDKDocumentation, SearchBuildAppsDocumentation, SearchWixHeadlessDocumentation, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, CallWixSiteAPI, ListWixSites, ManageWixSite, and SupportAndFeedback.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wix?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Wix in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Wix requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Wix failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wix scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Wix is developed by Wix. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
